title: NBA2 requirements register
source_note: Decomposed from the project brief (Arena session request of 2026-11-13) plus the engineering requirements needed to satisfy it. Status is a self-assessment against files in this repository, reviewed by a human owner next.

status_key.met: the artefact exists in the repo and works as described
status_key.partial: built, but one or more inputs/decisions are missing
status_key.blocked: cannot be completed until a data source or an owner decision exists
status_key.not started: identified as required, deliberately not attempted this session

requirements.requirement: Collect, organise and analyse NBA data behind one full requirements list
requirements.acceptance: A register with IDs, acceptance criteria and status that a reviewer can tick line by line
requirements.how: This file, rendered on /pages/requirements.html

requirements.requirement: Originate our own NBA lines rather than consuming a book's
requirements.acceptance: Spread and total for every game in the window produced by code from stored inputs
requirements.how: nba2/models/lines.py; 31/31 games priced on the current slate

requirements.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
requirements.acceptance: Named strategies with hypothesis, inputs, edge origin and correlation consequence
requirements.how: 9 strategies registered in nba2/config.py::STRATEGIES; usefulness is unproven until gates can be measured

requirements.requirement: Treat it as a leaderboard competition rewarding top strategies
requirements.acceptance: Scoring, tiers, clustering and reward allocation implemented and refusing to pay unmeasured entries
requirements.how: nba2/models/leaderboard.py; pool currently 100% unallocated by design

requirements.requirement: Cover single bets
requirements.acceptance: Spread, total and moneyline priced per game with probabilities and fair odds
requirements.how: lines table

requirements.requirement: Cover parlays
requirements.acceptance: Joint pricing that is not the product of the legs, with a correlation sweep
requirements.how: nba2/models/correlation.py::quote_pair (bivariate quadrature) + parlays table

requirements.requirement: Cover player prop bet combos
requirements.acceptance: Prop pricing math present and tested; combo legs priced with dependence
requirements.how: nba2/models/props.py implements NB tails + copula combos, but no official player-level input exists in the repo — every prop row is blank

requirements.requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates
requirements.acceptance: Gate engine where BLOCKED/AT-RISK are distinct from PASS and FAIL
requirements.how: nba2/models/gates.py::evaluate, 10 gates

requirements.requirement: Determine correlation values
requirements.acceptance: Correlations computed where data exists; band + sign-stability where it does not
requirements.how: 1 of 5 relevant correlations computable today (r(SRS, margin/G)); the other 4 need game/player level data

requirements.requirement: Remove luck from the equation
requirements.acceptance: Bootstrap CI, t-stat, calibration, CLV, multiple-testing control, and rewards not tied to recent PnL
requirements.how: Implemented in gates/leaderboard; cannot be evaluated until bets settle

requirements.requirement: Build selectively skill-based strategies
requirements.acceptance: Promotion requires measured edge surviving the luck checks; abstention is a first-class output
requirements.how: Tier logic + TRAF/S-02 selective betting; no promotions yet

requirements.requirement: Generate picks for every upcoming slate up to 3 days ahead
requirements.acceptance: 100% of games in the T+0..T+3 window have a line and a pick record
requirements.how: 31/31 games priced for 2026-11-13..16; picks expressed as triggers because no market price exists

requirements.requirement: Track how injuries affect rotation minutes and production
requirements.acceptance: Official statuses joined to per-team rotation depth, with minutes/production impact fields present
requirements.how: 91 official rows ingested; minutes/production columns blank by policy (report has no such fields)

requirements.requirement: Provide game flow analysis
requirements.acceptance: Schedule-spot analysis from official dates; in-game flow fields present but blank where data is missing
requirements.how: nba2/models/gameflow.py: B2B/3-in-4/load computed; pace, garbage time, foul trouble, closing lineups = None

requirements.requirement: Executive summary of important details
requirements.acceptance: One page with KPIs, findings, blockers and the single decision needed next
requirements.how: /pages/executive-summary.html

requirements.requirement: Suggest how to improve the site's decision quality
requirements.acceptance: Each suggestion states problem, proposal, benefit, effort, risk, recommendation
requirements.how: 18 items in suggestions/SUGGESTIONS.json

requirements.requirement: Dedicated suggestions section, reviewed before anything is implemented
requirements.acceptance: Nothing in the queue is auto-applied; queue state records the decision
requirements.how: /pages/suggestions.html reads the queue; status stays 'awaiting owner decision'

requirements.requirement: Clear list of questions/information/answers needed before decisions
requirements.acceptance: Each question states what we have, what we lack, how to find out and what it changes
requirements.how: 22 questions in requirements/QUESTIONS.json

requirements.requirement: Suggestions for discovering missing information
requirements.acceptance: Every open question carries a concrete retrieval route (endpoint, document or owner decision)
requirements.how: 'How to find out' column

requirements.requirement: No manual input required from the owner
requirements.acceptance: One command rebuilds everything from snapshots; no spreadsheet or copy-paste step
requirements.how: python -m nba2.pipeline.build_site_data && python -m nba2.pipeline.build_site

requirements.requirement: Work line by line, verify against official trusted sources, no hallucinations
requirements.acceptance: Per-row source on every table; unverifiable values blank; enforced by a build-time lint that fails the build
requirements.how: nba2/provenance.py::make_row raises on unsourceable values; nba2/pipeline/lint.py checks the emitted site

requirements.requirement: Provide links for manual review
requirements.acceptance: Every row's source is a clickable URL to the document it came from
requirements.how: source object per row in data/site.json; rendered as SRC link

requirements.requirement: Flag irregularities for review
requirements.acceptance: Flag registry with severity + action, published on its own page
requirements.how: 28 flags on /pages/flagged-review.html

requirements.requirement: GitHub Pages live site with clean landing page and subpages by category
requirements.acceptance: Site builds, publishes, and every nav link resolves
requirements.how: 15 pages; lint checks internal links; Pages workflow on push to main

requirements.requirement: Clean, user-friendly, simple dashboard UI with all entries in readable tables
requirements.acceptance: One table per topic, frozen headers, no data-less chrome
requirements.how: css/style.css + shared renderer in app.js

requirements.requirement: Every table row must have a source link to an official site
requirements.acceptance: Row without a source is impossible: constructor raises
requirements.how: make_row(source_key) required; lint re-checks the emitted JSON

requirements.requirement: If a value cannot be confirmed officially, leave it blank and flag it
requirements.acceptance: Blank cells are None in data and render as 'no official source'; never a dash pretending to be data
requirements.how: BLOCKED_ALLOWED_FIELDS carve-out in provenance.py; 100+ blank cells across the site

requirements.requirement: Never infer or fill in values
requirements.acceptance: No imputation anywhere in the pipeline; grep for fillna/backfill returns nothing
requirements.how: nba2 contains no imputation routine; verified by review and by tests

requirements.requirement: Parallel-session coordination via COORDINATION.md
requirements.acceptance: Board with claims, scopes, conflict log, handoff rule, takeover rule
requirements.how: COORDINATION.md, including the recorded add/add conflict resolution against main

requirements.requirement: PR to main, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy, record result
requirements.acceptance: PR opened, merged, deploy confirmed, all recorded on the board
requirements.how: see COORDINATION.md PR & Merge Results

requirements.requirement: Do not merge a broken site; publish flagged items instead of blocking
requirements.acceptance: Build gate + link check runs before merge; flags never block
requirements.how: nba2/pipeline/lint.py is a CI step

requirements.requirement: Reproduce every published number from committed inputs
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic rebuild byte-compares except the generated timestamp
requirements.how: seeded bootstrap, fixed grids, sorted output; test_reproducible_build

requirements.requirement: Home-court advantage and margin volatility must not be copied from folklore
requirements.acceptance: Both fitted from the snapshot; disagreement between fit and implied value disclosed
requirements.how: ratings.calibrate + FLAG-PARAM-02

requirements.requirement: Small-sample ratings must be shrunk, not trusted
requirements.acceptance: Reliability weight derived from the table's own dispersion
requirements.how: ratings.apply_shrinkage (empirical-Bayes)

requirements.requirement: A pick must not depend on where an unratified parameter sits
requirements.acceptance: Every line re-priced across the sensitivity box; side must hold on >=90% of the grid
requirements.how: lines._stability + gate G-08

requirements.requirement: No lookahead in evaluation
requirements.acceptance: Backtests rejected while inputs are not point-in-time
requirements.how: G-07 reports AT-RISK on purpose: an as-of standings table leaks; only the forward ledger is clean

requirements.requirement: Pre-register predictions so the leaderboard cannot be re-fitted
requirements.acceptance: Sealed JSON + sha256 committed with the site
requirements.how: nba2/models/ledger.py; digest shown in the site header

requirements.requirement: Settle predictions against official final scores
requirements.acceptance: Settlement computes MAE/Brier/log-loss/calibration; missing games listed, never imputed
requirements.how: ledger.settle implemented and unit-tested on fixtures; no finals file in repo yet

requirements.requirement: Stake sizing must respect model uncertainty, not confidence
requirements.acceptance: Fractional Kelly with a hard cap, and zero stake while no price exists
requirements.how: config staking + picks table stake column pinned to 0.00%

requirements.requirement: Slate ingest: date, time, teams, arena, broadcast, official game ID
requirements.acceptance: All 31 games with IDs read from the official page, none inferred
requirements.how: data/raw/slate_2026-11-13_to_11-16.json

requirements.requirement: Official injury report ingest with per-row attribution confidence
requirements.acceptance: Rows tagged explicit vs block-continuation; partial parse disclosed
requirements.how: data/raw/injury_report_2026-11-13.json + FLAG-INJ-01/03

requirements.requirement: Team rating inputs with cross-check against an official source
requirements.acceptance: Two W-L columns printed; mismatch fails the build
requirements.how: ratings table; lint rule wl_match

requirements.requirement: Market prices (spread/total/moneyline closing numbers)
requirements.acceptance: >=1 licensed book's opening and closing line per game
requirements.how: No odds feed reachable; this is the single largest blocker for CLV, ROI and 'value'

requirements.requirement: Player-level minutes, usage and production
requirements.acceptance: Per-player per-game box score with minutes, plus on/off
requirements.how: stats.nba.com unreachable from this environment (F-02)

requirements.requirement: Game-level results history for calibration and backtests
requirements.acceptance: >=2 seasons of final scores with game IDs
requirements.how: not in repo; every fitted parameter would be circular without it

requirements.requirement: Lineup/rotation data before tip
requirements.acceptance: Projected or confirmed lineups from an official source
requirements.how: NBA does not publish pre-tip lineups; starters are confirmable only after the game

requirements.requirement: Play-by-play for game flow
requirements.acceptance: Possession-level feed with timestamps
requirements.how: required before pace/garbage-time columns can be non-blank

requirements.requirement: Owner ratifies all unratified thresholds before money is risked
requirements.acceptance: Sign-off recorded in COORDINATION.md; config status flipped to 'ratified'
requirements.how: 11 parameters/gate thresholds listed on the Parameters page

requirements.requirement: Trial-count registry so multiple-testing correction is real
requirements.acceptance: Every evaluation attempt appended to a ledger and fed to G-06
requirements.how: S-11; without it Deflated Sharpe has no N

requirements.requirement: No live-money automation
requirements.acceptance: Site publishes lines and triggers only; no bet placement, no account credentials
requirements.how: no execution code exists in the repo, by design

requirements.requirement: Tests for the statistical machinery
requirements.acceptance: pytest suite covering calibration, shrinkage, gates math, copula pricing, ledger seal
requirements.how: nba2/tests/

requirements.requirement: CI that fails on unsourceable rows, broken links or test failures
requirements.acceptance: Workflow runs lint + pytest on PR
requirements.how: .github/workflows/ci.yml

requirements.requirement: Site must render with JavaScript disabled enough to read the flags
requirements.acceptance: static HTML contains headline numbers; tables hydrate from data/site.json
requirements.how: tables are hydrated client-side; headline cards are server-written into HTML

requirements.requirement: Timestamp and staleness visible everywhere
requirements.acceptance: as-of + generated-at + 'T-3 injury blind' notice on each data page
requirements.how: meta block rendered in every page header

requirements.requirement: Responsible-gambling and eligibility notice on a betting-related public site
requirements.acceptance: Footer notice with jurisdiction/age warning, no guarantees implied
requirements.how: footer on every page

requirements.requirement: Daily rebuild cadence with game-day 13:00 ET injury refresh
requirements.acceptance: Scheduled workflow; build aborts if snapshot is stale
requirements.how: needs a runner with network access to the official endpoints (this sandbox has none)

requirements.requirement: Snapshot retention so any published line can be re-derived
requirements.acceptance: dated files committed under data/raw/ + manifest
requirements.how: data/snapshots.meta.json

requirements.requirement: One Pages publishing path, no racing workflows
requirements.acceptance: exactly one workflow deploys
requirements.how: I-04 fixed: deploy.yml removed, pages.yml kept

requirements.requirement: State what the model cannot see (injuries, motivation, refs) inside the output, not in a footnote
requirements.acceptance: INJURY-BLIND column on every line row; Cup-game context column on the slate
requirements.how: lines table + game flow page

requirements.requirement: Distinguish verified from derived from third-party on every row
requirements.acceptance: source class badge per row
requirements.how: badge in every table

requirements.requirement: Licensed odds feed (opening + closing, spread/total/ML, and prop lines)
requirements.acceptance: vendor decision + API key + retention of closing prices per game
requirements.how: unblocks G-02, real edge, ROI, and stake sizing

requirements.requirement: Official player-level game data (minutes, usage, on/off)
requirements.acceptance: stats.nba.com equivalent reachable from the build environment
requirements.how: unblocks injury impact, props, and combo correlation

requirements.requirement: Historical final scores (>= 2 seasons) with NBA game IDs
requirements.acceptance: committed CSV/JSON snapshot + licence note
requirements.how: unblocks point-in-time backtests, sigma/HCA re-fit, margin/total correlation

requirements.requirement: Official standings/stats snapshot at a fixed daily time
requirements.acceptance: timestamped retrieval we can replay, replacing the third-party table
requirements.how: removes FLAG-RAT-01; needs network access from the runner

requirements.requirement: Bankroll and payout policy definition
requirements.acceptance: owner states bankroll units, max stake, and what the leaderboard pool pays on
requirements.how: Q-03/Q-13; staking currently pinned to 0%

requirements.requirement: Roster-mover and trade-context feed
requirements.acceptance: transactions with effective dates so ratings are re-based after a trade
requirements.how: this season already contains cross-team moves that change team-level ratings mid-window
